北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴冷，体感 -12℃。多穿点，注意保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels like -12°C. Dress warmly and stay cozy!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有雾，体感 -2℃。开车慢点，多添衣，注意防潮！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy and feels like -2°C. Drive safely, dress warm, and stay dry!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感 0℃。出门别忘添衣，小心着凉！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and feels like 0°C. Remember to layer up, stay warm!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 7℃。湿度高，记得带伞，别感冒咯！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is overcast and feels like 7°C. High humidity. Don't forget your umbrella!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 10℃。早晚温差大，记得加减衣物！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels like 10°C. Mind the temperature changes, dress accordingly!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有雾，体感 -2℃。能见度低，出行注意安全和保暖！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy, feels like -2°C. Low visibility, stay safe and warm!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京雾气浓，体感 -4℃。注意交通安全，做好防寒！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is very foggy, feels like -4°C. Drive carefully and keep warm!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度 100%。注意防潮，体感偏凉，多穿衣！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast with 100% humidity. It feels cool. Keep warm and stay dry!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾，体感 -4℃。出行注意安全，别忘了多添衣！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is very foggy and feels like -4°C. Drive safely, and dress warmly!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 -4℃。虽然有阳光，也要注意保暖哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny but feels like -4°C. Even with sun, remember to keep warm!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，体感 5℃。路面湿滑，出行小心，注意防寒！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy and feels like 5°C. Roads may be wet, travel safely and stay warm!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -29℃，严寒有雾。全副武装，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -29°C with fog. Bundle up completely, prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -29℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷，体感 -28℃。注意防寒保暖，别冻着了！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but feels like -28°C. Stay warm and don't get frozen!
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -28℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴天，体感 3℃。温差大，早晚注意添衣！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and feels like 3°C. Big temperature swings, dress wisely!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 10℃。风力 2级，早晚添衣，注意防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 10°C. Light breeze. Add layers in morning/evening!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛大雾，体感 -5℃。出行慢行，做好防寒保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy, feels like -5°C. Drive slowly, stay warm and bundled up!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -10℃。天冷，记得多穿点，注意保暖！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like -10°C. It's cold, dress warmly and stay cozy!
